best_candidate_rule.rule: highest mean person-level AUC over both experiments among ideas, excluding I2c; fixed before full-data results
best_candidate_rule.note: ablations A0-A3 are I3b preprocessing variants, not catalogue ideas; A0 0.846, A3 0.840, A2 0.837

edf_decode.note: edfapi float conversion; a live EyeLink link delivers samples without this cost

paper_rule_rate.parameters: peak sample index + 1-D logistic calibration (slope, intercept); detection itself needs only the peak index

I2b_bins_fusion.note: per-person normalisation statistics (2 x n_features) are computed at test time from the person's own control trials; they are not stored model parameters

notes.exp2_I4b_seconds_14589: wall time includes a session suspension, not compute time
